fewShots.question: Trace a guest stay from reservation to room and property.
fewShots.query: MATCH (g:Guest)-[:GuestBookedReservation]->(r:Reservation)-[:ReservationResultedInStay]->(s:Stay)-[:StayAssignedRoom]->(rm:Room)-[:PropertyHasRoom]->(p:Property) WHERE g.GuestId = 'GST-DEMO-FAMILY' RETURN g, r, s, rm, p;

fewShots.question: Show maintenance work connected to a stay.
fewShots.query: MATCH (s:Stay)-[:StayTriggeredMaintenanceRequest]->(m:MaintenanceRequest)-[:MaintenanceRequestTracksWorkOrder]->(w:WorkOrder) WHERE s.StayId = 'STY-DEMO-HVAC' RETURN s, m, w;
